vulnerability_patterns.description: Before the patch, devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one() constructed port dump replies by calling devlink_nl_port_fill() with the generic DEVLINK_CMD_NEW command value, so consumers of the generated netlink message observed a command type inconsistent with port-get responses and port notifications. After the patch, the same sink is called with DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW, replacing the wrong protocol constant with the port-specific command value.
trigger_conditions: Execution reaches devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one() and iterates devlink->ports via xa_for_each_start().
The port dump reply is constructed through devlink_nl_port_fill(msg, devlink_port, ...).
The command argument at that sink is DEVLINK_CMD_NEW instead of the port-specific DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW.
The generated dump response is consumed by code expecting the dumpit response command value to match the port get/doit response command.
fix_patterns: Replace the devlink_nl_port_fill() command argument DEVLINK_CMD_NEW with DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW in the port dump path.
Keep the sink and surrounding control flow unchanged; the barrier is semantic replacement of the incorrect enum value, not a runtime guard.
Use the operation-specific command constant when filling netlink messages for devlink port dump replies.

suggestions: First-draft checker should anchor on the patch-local sink devlink_nl_port_fill() inside devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one() and inspect its command argument.
Prioritize matching calls where the third argument is DEVLINK_CMD_NEW in a port dump/get context; this is the deleted dangerous expression.
Do not model guard absence, resource lifetime, bounds checks, or cleanup paths; the patch contains none of those mechanisms.
Use DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW as the expected replacement only as a convergence filter after finding the local sink and wrong constant.
Local AST matching is sufficient for an initial detector; no interprocedural data flow or cross-file analysis is required unless generalizing to other devlink fill helpers.
Auxiliary filters can require the enclosing function name devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one or the surrounding xa_for_each_start(&devlink->ports, ...) loop to reduce false positives.

analysis_rationale: The patch changes only the command argument passed to devlink_nl_port_fill() inside devlink_nl_port_get_dump_one(): the old dump path used DEVLINK_CMD_NEW, while the fixed path uses DEVLINK_CMD_PORT_NEW. There is no new guard, cleanup, lifetime change, or bounds check; the concrete mechanism is misuse of an enum/protocol command value at a message construction sink.
